> <h2>Tiny patch</h2> <p>This is a tiny release, but we thought it would be worth it.</p> <ul> <li>Updated <a href="https://github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea/releases/tag/v2.0.9">Bubble Tea</a> with a couple fixes for some terminal emulators.</li> <li>Updated <a href="https://github.com/charmbracelet/fantasy/releases/tag/v0.41.2">Fantasy</a> with fixes for AWS SSO and better cache hitting.</li> <li>Fixed wrong background color on permissions dialog. This was a regression from adding Bash syntax highlighting on <a href="https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/releases/tag/v0.89.0">v0.89.0</a>.</li> <li>Updated our <code>.gitattributes</code> to make development easier on Windows.
